visual_gripper_gate_provenance.kind: VLA-only empirical far-cube closure veto candidate, not official LeRobot default
visual_gripper_gate_provenance.semantics: Allows model opening; after opening intent/feedback, defers closure unless2 distinct wrist frames meet empirical near image conditions and observed grasp joint window with raw/feedback agreement<=3deg. It does not certify3D alignment/contact/grasp. Maximum8s from first deferred close to close-start, then stop. No new joint target or automatic opening target. Commit state only after acknowledged send. Same400ms/physical guards.

closure_sync_provenance.kind: Explicit local feedback phase constraint, not unmodified model output or official LeRobot default
closure_sync_provenance.evidence: 52 demonstrations: steady width42.5–45.4mm; ACT successful baseline actual44.5mm with target41.5mm. Latest failure:66.5→47.9mm before reopening.
closure_sync_provenance.semantics: After visual closure latch hold the measured six-joint pose and retain the minimum model closure intent with its original provenance; require fresh healthy feedback width42.5–45.5mm stable0.30s (range<=0.5mm) and previous ACK inward gap>=2mm. Four-second bound, empty/anchor/fault guards. ACK then discard old FIFO and re-infer. Stop premature opening outside the existing placement joint window. Force is diagnostic, width is only a holding candidate, not proof of grasp. Current feedback is re-read after inference, original model and camera source times are retained. At readiness a fixed carry ceiling retains at least2mm inward gap; small per-step opening cannot accumulate. Empty closure during carrying stops.
